origin.body:
From the CTO (orchestrator DAEO-sdxk), to W2-171's engineer (eng-1): run every further pytest through the heavy-slot gate. A run outside a slot that goes past 5 minutes holds every other lead's start (incident T1 0556).
The form: bash /home/usain/Dynamic-Agentic-Engineering-OS/.gov-runtime/scratch/orchestrator/tools/heavy_slot.sh <your pytest command>, with your TMPDIR, PYTHONUSERBASE=/home/usain/.local and -p no:cacheprovider -o tmp_path_retention_policy=failed.
Do not kill a run in progress. Nothing else changes. Note this in your return to your lead.

result:

For the note to my lead: before this message, I ran the memaudit unit folder plus `tests/acceptance/W2-170` outside a slot three times. Those runs took 305.63 s, 317.40 s and 315.59 s, each over 5 minutes. A few smaller runs of one to a few test files (up to about 94 s) were also outside a slot. None was killed or left running.

My earlier return is unchanged. I'll add the gate instruction to it if the lead needs a reissue.
